message.content:
A medium‑sized apple (about 182 grams or roughly 7–8 inches across) typically contains **around 95 kilocalories** (kcal).  

If you’re looking at different sizes:

| Size / Weight | Approximate Calories |
|---------------|----------------------|
| Small (~150 g) | ≈ 80 kcal |
| Medium (~180 g) | ≈ 95 kcal |
| Large (~220 g) | ≈ 115 kcal |

These figures can vary slightly depending on the variety of apple and how ripe it is, but they give a good ballpark estimate for most common apples like Red Delicious, Gala, Fuji, or Granny Smith.
